statement.zh: Giosan 等 2012：全新世加加尔–哈克拉为季风补给河流，而非大型冰川补给喜马拉雅河；干旱化与河流景观稳定相关。
statement.en: Giosan et al. 2012: Holocene Ghaggar-Hakra rivers were monsoon-fed, not a large glacier-fed Himalayan river; aridification linked to fluvial landscape stabilization.

editorial.notes: Derived only from civ MD + registered sources. No new archaeological inventions.
